blocks.prompt: 7. [printed as 6.] Find the ratio of the areas of the regions bounded by the parabola \(y = x^{2} - 4x + 3\) and the coordinate axes.
blocks.explanation:
Parabola coordinate axes ke saath do regions banata hai.
\(A_1\): curve, \(y\)-axis aur \(x\)-axis ke darmiyan, \(x = 0\) se pehle root tak (axis ke upar).
\(A_2\): curve aur \(x\)-axis ke darmiyan, dono roots ke beech (axis ke neeche).
Plan: roots nikalna, \([0, 1]\) aur \([1, 3]\) par integral, sizes lena, phir ratio \(A_1 : A_2\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = x^{2} - 4x + 3\) aur coordinate axes.
Maloom karna: \(A_1 : A_2\).
Tareeqa: Area under the curve; jo region axis ke neeche ho us ka area integral ka absolute value hota hai. Sketch bana kar pehle dono regions pehchan lijiye. Sawal mein "coordinate axes" ka matlab hai dono axes, yani \(x\)-axis aur \(y\)-axis. Pehla region dono axes ko chhoota hai, jabke doosra sirf \(x\)-axis aur curve ke beech band hai; is ki pehchan sketch ke baghair mushkil hai, is liye tasveer zaroor dekhiye.

Qadam 1: Intercepts
\[x^{2} - 4x + 3 = (x - 1)(x - 3) = 0\]
\[x = 1,\ x = 3;\quad y(0) = 3\]
Kyun: Roots curve ko do hisson mein baant dete hain: \(0 \le x \le 1\) par axis ke upar aur \(1 \le x \le 3\) par neeche. \(y\)-intercept \((0, 3)\) se \(A_1\) ka bayan kinara (\(y\)-axis) band hota hai.

Qadam 2: Antiderivative
\[F(x) = \dfrac{x^{3}}{3} - 2x^{2} + 3x\]
\[F(0) = 0,\ F(1) = \dfrac{4}{3},\ F(3) = 9 - 18 + 9 = 0\]
Kyun: Ek hi antiderivative dono regions ke kaam aata hai; teeno points par value ek dafa nikal li.
Dhyan dein: \(F(1) = \frac{1}{3} - 2 + 3 = \frac{4}{3}\); \(-2 + 3 = 1 = \frac{3}{3}\) jama \(\frac{1}{3}\).

Qadam 3: Dono areas
\[A_1 = F(1) - F(0) = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
\[A_2 = \left|F(3) - F(1)\right| = \left|-\dfrac{4}{3}\right| = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
Kyun: \(A_2\) axis ke neeche hai, us ka integral negative aaya, is liye absolute value liya. Ratio areas ka hota hai, aur area kabhi negative nahi hota.

Qadam 4: Ratio
\[A_1 : A_2 = \dfrac{4}{3} : \dfrac{4}{3} = 1 : 1\]
Kyun: Dono areas barabar hain, is liye ratio \(1 : 1\). Ratio hamesha sab se chhoti shakal mein likhte hain; \(\frac{4}{3} : \frac{4}{3}\) ko dono taraf \(\frac{4}{3}\) se divide karne par \(1 : 1\) mil jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Kuch students sirf \(\int_0^3 y\,dx = 0\) nikal kar ruk jate hain; zero area nahi, yeh sirf batata hai ke upar aur neeche ke hisse barabar hain.

Tasdeeq:
\(\int_0^3 y\,dx = F(3) - F(0) = 0\). Matlab axis ke upar wala area neeche wale area ko poora cancel kar deta hai, jo tabhi mumkin hai jab \(A_1 = A_2\) ho. Jawab pakka hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(A_1 = A_2 = \frac{4}{3}\) square units, is liye ratio \(1 : 1\) hai.
